posts.title: It’s Been a Minute
posts.description: The 2026 midterm elections were five days ago as i write this. Going into the election, I thought taking the Senate was an extreme long shot and that the House would be a likely scant majority. As we know, the results were a near best case scenario for Democrats. The wave was big and blue. By late Tuesday evening when I realized the scope of the results I cried with the vastness of the change and the pent up trauma of the last 10 years. Voters directly affected by the gutting of the VRA voted to save their future as equal citizens. Incoming Congress, do not screw them over. Justice, fairness, kindness, and democracy will all suffer if we don’t protect their rights. Voters harmed by war, tariffs, and policies that protect billionaires made their anger heard. Incoming Congress, take all necessary and possible actions to redress those harms. Voters who were sick of the open corruption of the GOP made their anger heard. posts.title: Another Killing
posts.description: ICE has killed another protester in Minnesota. Early reports are that it was an execution. Here’s what I know: Kristie Noem is going to stand up and lie about what happened The Fascist regime will blame the victim The GOP will clap and titter in glee because they are murderous ghouls Call your Senators and Reps. Call out the fascists for the racist, hateful, liars they are. Mock them without mercy. If someone speaks approvingly of the administration do not let that go unanswered.
